invariants: the selected file resolves only from extension-visible frozen file views
an absent or filtered-out file produces a completely empty selection
stale hunk indexes floor and clamp to the actual hunk range
nonfinite hunk indexes and files without hunks produce no hunk selection
current line is copied only when its file and hunk match the resolved selection
returned selection file and current line cannot mutate their source views

nativeProtocolAdaptation.immutability: owned Rust values replace JavaScript Object.freeze and shared object identity
nativeProtocolAdaptation.transport: the frozen selection is serialized with each native command invocation
